environment_spec.name: cellquant-hpc
cuda_notes: Prefer one shared cellquant-hpc env with a CUDA 12.8+ (cu128) PyTorch wheel: includes Blackwell sm_120 and older arches (A100/L40/H200).
Do not reuse an older cu121/cu124 wheel that only lists through sm_90 — jobs fail-fast with an upgrade recipe.
Upgrade on a login node: python -m pip install --upgrade torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128
CURC FAQ recommends nvhpc_sdk/2025.251 or newer; validate model init + inference + parity.
notes: Submit enabled for comparative Alpine trials; H200 remains the recommended default partition until smoke_verified_utc is set.
Request full GPU GRES gpu:rtx_pro_6000:1 (not MIG 1g/2g slices).
Record smoke_verified_utc after a successful matched trial.
Not listed for gpu-testing; use short gpu-normal for smoke/benchmark jobs.
Never advertise as faster merely because the GPU is newer.
Promote to recommended only after matched benchmark + parity; keep H200 selectable.
